requirement: Input paths must be repository-relative without parent components and must resolve inside the repository even after following symlinks.
justification: Scenarios: normal relative file, empty/absolute/parent paths, missing files, outside symlink and contained symlink. contained rejects forbidden components before canonicalizing and checks the resolved prefix. Tests cover both rejection of escapes and acceptance of a safe internal symlink. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions.
